dependencies.reason: The root EBS volume is defined by the instance's block device mapping and is created with the instance. It is EBS, NOT S3.
dependencies.securityImpact: EBS volumes should be encrypted; access is controlled by the instance.
dependencies.costImpact: Root EBS volume incurs per-GB storage cost for the lab duration.

dependencies.reason: A VPC provides the isolated network the instance and subnet reside in.
dependencies.securityImpact: Defines the network boundary. No inbound internet access without an internet gateway and route.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the VPC itself.

dependencies.reason: A subnet within the VPC is required to launch the EC2 instance.
dependencies.securityImpact: MapPublicIpOnLaunch is left disabled unless public access is requested.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the subnet.

dependencies.reason: A security group is attached so inbound access is denied unless an ingress rule is explicitly added by the author.
dependencies.securityImpact: Default posture allows no inbound traffic. Ingress rules are opt-in and reviewed.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the security group.

dependencies.reason: An internet gateway plus a default route are only added when the author explicitly requests inbound/outbound internet access.
dependencies.securityImpact: Enables internet exposure. Requires justification and restrictive security group rules.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the internet gateway, but public IPv4 addresses incur an hourly charge.

dependencies.reason: A route table with a default route to the internet gateway is only added when public access is requested.
dependencies.securityImpact: Adds a route to the internet gateway, enabling egress/ingress paths.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the route table.

evidence.rationale: Authoritative property set for the EC2 instance resource.

limitations: Instance type availability and vCPU quotas vary by region and account; this tool cannot confirm live availability.
AMI ids are region-specific; prefer an SSM public parameter alias over a hard-coded AMI id.
